What We Do

Protective systems
for every surface.

From underground parkades to penthouse balconies, we deliver coatings engineered to perform under traffic, weather, and time.

Traffic Coatings

Heavy-duty vehicular traffic membranes engineered for parkades and ramps.

Waterproofing Systems

Liquid-applied membranes that seal decks, plazas and amenity spaces.

Concrete Coating & Sealing

Protective sealers that extend concrete life and resist chemical wear.

Deck & Balcony Protection

Slip-resistant, weather-tight finishes built for residential decks.

Parkade & Surface Restoration

Full restoration of aging parking structures, joints and surfaces.

Structural Surface Protection

Long-term protective systems for high-traffic structural assets.
